title.zh: 卷二百二十四 表第十五 宗室世系十
title.en: Volume 224 Tables 15: Geneology of the Imperial Clan 10

sentences.zh: 太宗九子：長漢王元佐，次昭成太子元僖，次真宗，次商王元份，次越王元傑，次鎮王元偓，次楚王元偁，次周王元儼，次崇王元億世絕。

translations.literal: Taizong's nine sons: the eldest was Prince of Han Yuanzuo; next, Heir Apparent Zhaocheng Yuanxi; next, Zhenzong; next, Prince of Shang Yuanfen; next, Prince of Yue Yuanjie; next, Prince of Zhen Yuanwei; next, Prince of Chu Yuancheng; next, Prince of Zhou Yuanyan; next, Prince of Chong Yuanyi — whose line ended.
